# The coord language — grounding pack (taifoon.pipe.lang.v1, generated; do not edit)

## Tornado — the three steps of engagement (docs/TORNADO.md)
1. coord: read and stream any venue's transitions — t.stream, t.coord.stream, GET /v1/protocol/:p/order/:key, GET /v1/pipe/stream (venue → lane → leaf under the superroot → the stream).
2. Tornado: transform any type into a sendable envelope and submit it under a valid key; Twigster signs it for the key's actor — t.coord.envelope.toEnvelope, t.send, POST /v1/pipe/send; every transformation is a row of GET /v1/lambda/catalog.
3. settle: the vacuum and the transitions onto any venue through its traits (VenueRead · VenueSettle · VenueProve · VenueQuote), any to any — the carriers behind POST /v1/pipe/send (evm · solana · venue · http), the settle plans; the venues' readiness (ready · partial · missing per capability) is register/tornado-venues.json (t.coord.tornado).

Every envelope is a transition. A READ arrives as kind `observe` from the producer (GET /v1/pipe/stream); a WRITE is sent with POST /v1/pipe/send, names its transition, carries the transition's kind, and writes to one outlet the caller's key holds.

Kinds a send may carry: offer, hire, delivery, grade, settle, release, advert, cover, ack, record, signal. Read-only kinds: observe.
Outlets: mainnet, devnet, taifoon, vaults. Vault venues write to `vaults`; eip155:36927 → devnet; eip155:3692781 → taifoon; any other chain → mainnet; a watch or an http delivery writes to no outlet.

Carrier routes (first match wins):
1. record: agent_is=audit, venue_is=coord, kinds=record, exclusive=true
2. record: venue_is=coord, kinds=signal, exclusive=true
3. watch: venue_is=coord, endpoint=absent, kinds=hire|settle|release|delivery, exclusive=false
4. vault: venue_is=vault, kinds=settle|release, exclusive=false
5. vault: venue_is=vaults, kinds=settle|release, exclusive=false
6. vault: venue_is=vault_server, kinds=settle|release, exclusive=false
7. vault: venue_is=custody_registry, kinds=settle|release, exclusive=false
8. vault: venue_is=service:vault, kinds=settle|release, exclusive=false
9. vault: venue_is=service:custody, kinds=settle|release, exclusive=false
10. http: endpoint=http, kinds=any, exclusive=false
11. solana: chain_prefix=solana, kinds=settle|release, exclusive=false
12. venue: venue=present, kinds=any, exclusive=false
13. evm: chain_prefix=eip155:, kinds=settle|release, exclusive=false
14. solana: chain_prefix=solana, agent=present, kinds=any, exclusive=false
